en.t: After finishing his poem, he went inside.
After that, no one came out again.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得就此回去，不免乏味。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that simply going home like this would be rather dull.

units.source_text: 然而天色渐明，教人见了不便，就不进门去，匆匆回二条院了。

en.t: But as the sky was gradually growing light, it would be awkward if someone saw him, so he did not go in through the gate and hurried back to Nijo-in.
